extraction.Name: Alice Clifford
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County, South Dakota (agency not stated)
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent to her 160 acre allotment at the time it was issued, but that she was informed by the Indian Agency it would be taxed, and finally sold for same, if she did not take the patent over, so she did it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: she has never mortgaged this place, nor sold it; that it is clear of debt now, except for $2900.00 taxes against it
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: she was informed by the Indian Agency it would be taxed, and finally sold for same, if she did not take the patent over
extraction.Occupation/Income: supported by her husband, who has good health, and who runs a dairy on her land for a living, this being his only income
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, has good health; husband runs a dairy on her land; allotment is 160 acres; $2900.00 in taxes against the land; has never received any help from the County, State nor the United States Government; document sworn December 5, 1928
